verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API-testing/design platform whose AI-agent integration story is that it exposes its own collections/requests via an official MCP server for external agents to consume (hoppscotch-docs-10, hoppscotch-probe-3, hoppscotch-probe-6) — i.e., it plays the MCP server role, not the MCP client role. There is no evidence of Hoppscotch itself acting as an agent that plugs in and consumes third-party MCP servers' tools, and this is not a fair capability to expect of an API client/testing tool.
